papers.title: NKCC1 coordinates SPAK-PP1 signalling to regulate KCC2 membrane stability and seizure susceptibility.
papers.title_zh: NKCC1协调SPAK-PP1信号传导，以调节KCC2膜稳定性和癫痫发作易感性。
papers.abstract: Chloride homeostasis, and thereby the efficacy of chloride-permeable GABAA receptor signaling, depends on the dynamic balance between NKCC1 (Na+-K+-2Cl- cotransporter 1) and KCC2 (K+-Cl- cotransporter 2), which respectively mediate chloride influx and extrusion to tightly control intracellular chloride concentration ([Cl-]i). Here, we uncover an unexpected mechanism by which NKCC1 regulates KCC2 membrane stability and function. Co-immunoprecipitation experiments from mouse brain lysates revealed that KCC2 associates with NKCC1 and SPAK (STE20/SPS1-related proline-alanine-rich kinase), indicating that these proteins are within a common molecular interaction network. Furthermore, we show that NKCC1 and KCC2 form co-clusters in the plasma membrane of hippocampal neurons and that freely diffusing KCC2 molecules become trapped within NKCC1 membrane clusters. These observations suggest that NKCC1 coordinates SPAK- and PP1-dependent regulation of KCC2. Guided by molecular modeling, we designed peptides targeting specific interactions within this complex. Peptides that activate SPAK by engaging NKCC1's PP1-binding motif decrease KCC2 surface expression and impair chloride extrusion, whereas a SPAK-inhibiting peptide that prevents SPAK recruitment to NKCC1, stabilizes KCC2 in membrane clusters, and enhances chloride extrusion. An optimized peptide analog suitable for in vivo use preserves KCC2 clustering under hyperexcitable conditions, reduces seizure frequency and severity in an acute pentylenetetrazol-induced (PTZ) seizure model, and suppresses ictal activity in chronically epileptic human tissue. Together, these findings identify NKCC1 as a key regulator of KCC2 membrane stability, reveal NKCC1-KCC2 coupling as a critical determinant of inhibitory signaling, and establish this complex as a potential therapeutic target for restoring chloride homeostasis in epilepsy and related neurological disorders.
papers.abstract_zh:
氯化物稳态以及氯化物渗透性GABAA受体信号传导的功效取决于NKCC1 （ Na + -K + -2Cl-协同转运蛋白1 ）和KCC2 （ K + -Cl-协同转运蛋白2 ）之间的动态平衡，它们分别介导氯化物流入和挤出以严格控制细胞内氯化物浓度（ [Cl-] i ）。在这里，我们揭示了NKCC1调节KCC2膜稳定性和功能的意外机制。
来自小鼠脑裂解物的实验表明， KCC2与NKCC1和SPAK （ STE20/SPS1相关的富含脯氨酸-丙氨酸的激酶）相关，表明这些蛋白质位于共同的分子相互作用网络中。此外，我们表明NKCC1和KCC2在海马神经元的质膜中形成共簇，并且自由扩散的KCC2分子被捕获在NKCC1膜簇内。这些观察表明， NK
CC1协调KCC2的SPAK和PP1依赖性调节。在分子建模的指导下，我们设计了针对该复合物内特定相互作用的肽。通过NKCC1的PP1结合基序激活SPAK的肽会降低KCC2的表面表达并损害氯化物挤出，而SPAK抑制肽会阻止SPAK募集到NKCC1 ，稳定膜簇中的KCC2 ，并增强氯化物挤出。
适用于体内使用的肽类似物在过度兴奋条件下保留了KCC2聚集，降低了急性戊四氮诱导（ PTZ ）癫痫发作模型中的癫痫发作频率和严重程度，并抑制了慢性癫痫人体组织的发作活性。这些发现共同确定了NKCC1是KCC2膜稳定性的关键调节因子，揭示了NKCC1-KCC2偶联是抑制信号传导的关键决定因素，并建立了
是癫痫和相关神经系统疾病中恢复氯化物稳态的潜在治疗靶点。

papers.title: Tuning of AMPA receptor activation by inhibitory auxiliary subunits and epilepsy-associated disease mutations.
papers.title_zh: 通过抑制性辅助亚单位和癫痫相关疾病突变调节AMPA受体活化。
papers.abstract: AMPA receptors (AMPARs) facilitate excitatory neurotransmission and are implicated in neurological and neuropsychiatric disorders. Binding of the neurotransmitter glutamate triggers AMPAR activation, which is modulated by potentiating and inhibitory auxiliary subunits. While modulation by potentiating auxiliary subunits has been studied extensively, activation involving inhibitory subunits has not been examined. Here, we present structures of the activated GluA2 AMPAR alone and in complex with inhibitory subunits GSG1L or γ5. Our results suggest that gating kinetics strongly depend on auxiliary subunit identity, while pore size and conductance do not. We find that receptor deactivation becomes slower if an auxiliary subunit promotes tightening of the interface between two ligand-binding domain dimers during activation. In addition, we functionally characterize the effects of epilepsy-associated disease mutations on AMPAR activation and desensitization kinetics, displaying strong dependence on the type of bound auxiliary subunit. Modulation by auxiliary subunits therefore has to be considered when designing AMPAR-targeting therapeutics.
papers.abstract_zh:
AMPA受体（ AMPAR ）促进兴奋性神经传递，并与神经和神经精神疾病有关。神经递质谷氨酸的结合触发AMPAR激活，其通过增强和抑制辅助亚基来调节。虽然通过增强辅助亚基的调节已得到广泛研究，但尚未研究涉及抑制亚基的活化。在这里，我们展示了
单独和与抑制亚基GSG1L或γ5复合物中激活的GluA2 AMPAR。我们的研究结果表明，门控动力学高度依赖于辅助亚基同一性，而孔径和电导则不然。我们发现，如果辅助亚基在激活过程中促进两个配体结合结构域二聚体之间的界面收紧，受体失活就会变慢。此外，我们在功能上表征了癫痫屁股的影响
在AMPAR激活和脱敏动力学上发生疾病突变，表现出对结合的辅助亚单位类型的强烈依赖性。因此，在设计靶向AMPAR的治疗剂时，必须考虑辅助亚单位的调节。
